answer: The plume report shows the merge explicitly at each garden. Because of that, an hostile operator who spins up 178 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 137 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one vault weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A farm of 1514 identities would post 3321 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
